outcome: In-hospital mortality rate due to CAs
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 25,073 live births in Qatar between April 2017 and March 2018
finding: The incidence of any CA among live births was 1.3%, with CVS anomalies being the most common, and several maternal and infant factors were associated with specific CAs.
mod_finding: CAs were significantly associated with high rates of caesarean deliveries.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with CAs
